notices.title: Amber Warning (Be Prepared) - Thunderstorms (Today)
notices.text: There is an increased likelihood of severe lightning associated with thundershowers at several places in the following areas during the evening or night. Thundershowers accompanied by heavy rainfall of about 100 mm are likely at some places in the Western, Sabaragamuwa and Central provinces and in the Galle, Matara and Kurunegala districts. Frequent lightning is also likely at some places in the aforementioned areas.
